remarks: Beautiful upcoming bungalow with possession expected mid november, offering approximately 2,737 sq. ft. of developed living space across both levels. The main floor features an impressive open-to-below foyer, spacious living and dining area, a functional kitchen with pantry, mudroom access, and convenient laundry area. The primary bedroom includes an ensuite bath and walk-in closet, while the second bedroom is served by an additional full 4-piece bathroom. The fully developed basement offers 2 more bedrooms, both with walk-in closets, another full bathroom, a large recreation area, and a spacious wet bar setup perfect for entertaining or extended family living. Thoughtfully designed with both comfort and functionality in mind, this home is an excellent opportunity for families looking for modern bungalow living with ample space throughout.
